messages:
alexa: FYI the mkdocs linkcheck job is red on the localized site, failing with anchor remap errors and a bunch of 404s for fragments. started after the i18n rename.
jia: ugh, saw that. error looks like it choked on unicode normalization — some headings have zero-width joiners and emoji, and the slugify step turned them into weird percent-escapes.
sam: can you paste the failing log lines?
alexa: sure — from the CI run:
```
WARNING: Could not resolve '#overview-–-ключевые-фичи' in page 'guide/overview.md'
WARNING: Found bad fragment in 'guide/overview.md': '#overview-–-ключевые-фичи'
```
jia: that `–` (en dash) and the Cyrillic text plus a hidden ZWJ are making the slug differ between renderer and linkcheck. linkcheck uses `slugify` with NFC, our mkdocs build uses NFKC? mismatch.
matt: i'd expect we normalized in the i18n pipeline but maybe not. which repo/PR introduced the headings?
alexa: PR #1427 — locale folder rename and heading edits by @moon. It passed locally for me (macos) but CI container is linux with older python-slugify.
docs-bot: deploy-bot reported: mkdocs/linkcheck v1.3.8 — running in ubuntu-20.04 container; slugify package==0.0.4
sam: quick mitigation: we can add an explicit slug in the md heading for problem lines, e.g. `## Ключевые фичи {#overview-key-features-ru}` but that's manual and noisy for all headings.
jia: better: pin a consistent slugify behavior in our docs build. Add a `markdown_extensions` config with `toc` slugify function that uses `python-slugify` with `lower=False, allow_unicode=True` and normalize to NFC. Also upgrade the slugify lib in the CI image.
alexa: proposed mkdocs.yml snippet:
```
markdown_extensions:
  - toc:
      permalink: true
      slugify: !python/name:mydocs.utils.nfc_slugify
```
(with mydocs.utils.nfc_slugify defined in the docs package to run unicodedata.normalize('NFC', text) before slugify)
matt: that sounds good. can you open a tiny PR with two commits: (1) bump slugify in dockerfile/ci, (2) add normalization hook + tests for emoji/ZWJ/Cyrillic headings?
alexa: will do. tagging @moon for verification, and leaving a fallback plan: add explicit `{#...}` anchors for the handful of problematic headings if CI still complains.
deploy-bot: CI queued for PR #1430 (docs/slugs): build/linkcheck starting...
sam: thanks — also add a short note in the docs contributing guide: "use NFC for heading text" so translators follow the same normalization.
jia: one more gotcha: some translators paste soft hyphens (U+00AD) — maybe strip those in the slugify helper.
alexa: good call. I'll include a sanitize step. Opening PR in ~20m and will paste link here. :thumbsup:
alexa: PR #1430 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1430 — includes CI image bump, slugify helper, and unit tests. request reviews from @jia @matt @moon
matt: reviewing now. small nit on test names but LGTM pending green CI. :eyes:
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #1430 — linkcheck OK, mkdocs build completed.
alexa: thanks all! follow-up: i added CONTRIBUTING.md note about normalization and a tiny script `tools/normalize-headings.py` for bulk fixes. closing thread.
